newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish queen leaves hospital after knee checkup.
newsitem.headline: Danish queen leaves hospital after knee checkup.

text.p: Danish Queen Margrethe was released from hospital and ordered to rest on Thursday after undergoing treatment for a minor knee injury which forced her to cut short a visit to Greenland.
"The queen was suffering from degenerative joint disease and strain on her knee. There were no complications that required an operation," the Royal Danish court said in a statement.

It said that the queen was given treatment and advised to rest her knee for the next few weeks. Queen Margrethe, 57, flew back to hospital in Denmark on Wednesday, curtailing a visit to Greenland to mark the 25th anniversary of her accession to the throne in 1972.
The queen, accompanied by her French husband Prince Henrik, their younger son Prince Joachim and his Hong Kong-born wife Princess Alexandra, arrived in Greenland on August 1.
The visit to Greenland, which has home rule under Denmark, was to have lasted until August 17.
